notes: This is a Microsoft Forms export: four parts (A-D), each with Question 1 (type your name; not a question, skipped) and Questions 2-13 at 1 mark each (12 marks per part, 48 total). Question numbers restart in each part, so to keep them unique the number is stored with the part letter (A2 ... D13) and section is the part letter; the printed number is the part after the letter. Solutions are the handwritten annotated copy (pages 35-69) of the same paper; answers read from circled options, working transcribed from handwriting and guideline drawings cropped as solution figures. Typos in paper: B6 table 2019-2020 row printed '$18 201 - $37 00' (should be $37 000); C13 'is show below' (shown); C3 'results ... are shown'. Handwritten solution C3 writes 6.6 for 8.6 on the male curve (not corrected in the paper text). D10 handwritten working sums edge weights at each vertex (35, 25, 20, 44) rather than counting edges; the circled answer D is correct either way. D3 handwritten note on Line 1 is hard to read; transcribed cautiously. Solutions D12 shows the end vertex as 15 | 17 in the handwriting. Tables B2, C3, C4, D7, D11, D12 stored as table data; B4 and B6 tables and all diagrams cropped as figures. D6 diagrams (A)-(D) cropped as one figure with options as '(A)'-'(D)'.
